font_families.font_family_cn: Android platform SansSerif; Android OS resolves CJK by script and locale, with no vendor-specific face pinned.
font_families.font_family_digits: Android platform SansSerif; no tabular-digit face is declared.
font_families.license: No app-bundled font or repository-level font license artifact exists. The mapped face is supplied by Android; the repository does not pin a vendor face or redistribute a font.
font_families.fallback: Android OS script/locale-aware fallback for CJK and other missing glyphs; exact vendor face is intentionally not pinned.
font_families.portability: Android-specific mapping; other renderers require an explicit platform mapping and cannot infer a font from a screenshot.
font_families.resolution_scope: All dynamic Chinese, English and numeric UI text; Brand Typography is a separate artwork asset role.

tokens.usage: Page title unless a registered navigation/page exception applies.

tokens.usage: Generic button label; component contract takes precedence.

tokens.name: Numeric

allowed: Brand Hero / 渔见 wordmark may only reference brand_asset_contract; dynamic text, a new typeface, or a page-selected brand font is forbidden.
Fish Species Name may use its registered page size/line-height while retaining the shared platform family and weight catalog.
Large Statistic may use the registered Normal Home Font A reference-pixel mapping, which converts to sp and continues to honor OS fontScale.
forbidden: Page-private font family, page-selected brand font, or unregistered fallback.
Page-defined private size scale outside a referenced page authority.
Dynamic brand text for the frozen 渔见 wordmark; do not simulate or redraw brand glyphs.
Silent text shrink, canceled fontScale, unregistered letter spacing, or color literals.
override_policy.shared_family_change_requires: A platform family change requires a separately recorded owner decision; do not replace a Frozen page visual.

page_overrides.rule: Use the registered Frozen Artwork Asset reference only; dynamic_text=false and font_dependency=none. This policy does not authorize editing, cropping, extraction, or regeneration of the Frozen raster.
Page authority may set size and line-height for species hierarchy; family and weight remain in shared catalog; preserve page authority.
Use Normal Home Font A reference-pixel mapping and its explicit width/density conversion to sp. Keep source values page-scoped; OS fontScale remains enabled.
Use the registered centered-title exception and state-specific result contract; do not promote its geometry to a global navigation variant.
Use the registered Frozen Artwork Asset authority for brand lettering; retain the page Frozen composition and do not create a page-private font or artwork variant.

page_audit.finding: Brand lettering is governed by the registered frozen artwork reference; no typeface is inferred from raster pixels. Page placement remains page-scoped.
Font A remains a registered page override with OS fontScale. The 渔见 wordmark role is an artwork asset, not dynamic text or a font choice; no bitmap content was changed.
Centered title and state-specific result typography remain page authorities.
Shared family with page-scoped media text / ON_MEDIA color roles; A/B Frozen visuals remain authoritative.
Species title sizing is page-owned; large text grows its container and keeps semantic order.

tracking_rule: 0sp unless a page/component authority registers a specific override.
font_scale_rule: Honor Android OS fontScale; expand containers and scroll when needed; never silently shrink or cancel scaling.

decision_records.approved_policy: Dynamic UI text uses Android platform Typography Tokens with OS script/locale CJK fallback. Brand Typography uses a FROZEN_ARTWORK_ASSET with dynamic_text=false and font_dependency=none.
decision_records.source: Approved in the Phase 2 Final Freeze work instruction.
decision_records.forbidden: No new calligraphic font, no Android simulated brand font, no page-selected brand font, and no logo glyph redraw.

brand_asset_contract.usage: 渔见 brand wordmark and special brand visual lettering only.
brand_asset_contract.authority: Frozen Normal Home artwork reference; the existing image bytes are unchanged.
brand_asset_contract.boundary: This is the registered frozen artwork authority, not an authorization to extract, crop, regenerate, redraw, or modify the bitmap. Page placement/geometry remains page-owned and is handled in Phase 3.
